shared_elements: single large standing anthropomorphic figure occupying the whole upright panel
figure shown in relief carved on a tall rectangular slab
feather-like / plumed elements flanking the figure's body
elaborate headdress or crest at the top of the figure
small detailed motifs or signs at the lower part of the field
justification: Both surfaces show one dominant standing figure filling a tall upright field, with headdress above and plumed or feathered appendages spreading at the sides, which is the most specific correspondence. But A is a strictly profile figure with a bird head, one arm raised and a handled bucket held low, rendered with fine naturalistic anatomical and feather detail, whereas B's figure appears frontal, blocky and schematic with arms held before the body and no comparable held attributes.
